notes.title: Cardful Planning's big update is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

[b]The big update is finally ready!
[/b]
With this update, Cardful Planning now has a little over 100 rooms to complete and is now more or less on par with the Switch version!

Here are some of the new additions:

- An extra 50 rooms to complete, including 1 whole new area
- A new ending cutscene to properly end the story
- Some small tweaks to visuals, UI, and gameplay
- New help text for various levels
- Support for triggers and bumpers for using the Heart and Spade abilities
- Separate saves for each game mode

[b]There are a few things to note:[/b]

[b]1. If you have any old saves then unfortunately, they will be wiped when you launch the update. Since the content was doubled I just couldn't find a smooth solution for people to be able to continue their old save.
On the positive side though, the game can now keep a separate save for each mode in the game!

2. Scores on the online leaderboards have been adjusted. Now, anyone that completed the game before the update will be shown as only having completed 50% of the game instead of the 100% that it was originally.[/b]


I hope you all enjoy the new update and please let me know if you encounter any issues!

Thanks,
James
Walk Home Games

notes.title: Update Notes for May 24, 2021

Hello Everyone

Here are the latest bug fixes and improvements made

- Various room tweaks and shuffling of rooms to improve room flow 
- More tutorial text and better written tutorial text for various rooms
- Fixed issue with Card going over an Ace value causing it to change suit

- Fixed issue with Heart Boss audio continuing to play shortly after death
- Fixed issue with two blocks that are not on tiles becoming immobile and unable to be moved together

Thanks,
